Products.metaTitle: Custom Packaging Products in 3D: Boxes & Cups | PackJoyU
Products.metaDescription: Explore 12 custom packaging categories in 3D: corrugated boxes, gift and wine boxes, molded pulp, paper cups and printing. Request a quote from PackJoyU.

desc.corrugated-boxes: Custom corrugated shipping and mailer boxes in single and double wall, printed with your brand.
desc.color-boxes: Full-color printed folding cartons and retail product boxes for cosmetics, food and electronics.
desc.gift-boxes: Rigid and magnetic custom gift boxes with foil stamping, embossing and fitted inserts.
desc.pulp-molding: Molded pulp trays and inserts made from paper and sugarcane fiber.
desc.paper-cups: Custom printed paper cups for coffee, tea and cold drinks, in single and double wall.
desc.party-supplies: Printed paper party tableware: plates, cups, napkins and decorations for events and retail.
desc.wine-boxes: Custom wine and spirits boxes for one or more bottles, with premium finishes and inserts.
desc.color-printing: CMYK and spot-color printing for packaging, labels and marketing materials.
desc.offset-printing: Offset printing for boxes, catalogs and brochures with consistent color at volume.
desc.eco-paper-cups: Paper cups printed with your logo; coating options confirmed per order.
desc.gift-cards: Custom printed gift cards, greeting cards and card packaging for retail and promotions.
desc.christmas-merchandise: Christmas gift boxes, tubes, advent calendars and seasonal packaging made to order.

corrugated-boxes: Up to 4-color flexo or digital print
